checks.require: Approved design, independent audit and separate human authorization for actual import
Reviewed implementation commit and clean worktree; no unreviewed SQL templates
Explicit --confirm-remote-import plus --execute; default dry-run has no remote binding
Cloudflare account and exact database ID/name verified; every other ID rejected, including T06
Node management process + explicitly configured getPlatformProxy env.DB; loopback auth only; no production import route; proxy lifecycle disposed
Original source file read-only; exact source SHA allowlist verified before parsing and before submission
v2 JSON contract valid; source row counts match approved snapshot
Source PK/unique/request keys/FK/current_version/completion/duration checks valid
Approved exact-source trigger strategy: acyclic copies, referenced sources completed/non-archived, no open logs
Remote migrations 0001~0005 once each; unchanged migration hashes
All business/auth columns, FK, indexes and CHECK SQL match approved normalized schema
Exactly 17 approved trigger names and normalized SQL; no disabled or extra guards
Six remote business tables empty; verified once in preflight and again atomically in first batch write
Exactly one user; explicit owner ID plus expected email pair, personally signed up through existing Better Auth
Exactly one account, providerId=credential, userId=owner, accountId=owner; credential non-null checked without printing value
Immediate normal logout, sessions zero; local auth listener stopped and in-flight requests drained before batch
PRAGMA foreign_key_check zero violations; FK enforcement enabled, never toggled off
Final production Worker absent; no public routes/aliases/preview business write path; only scoped binding proxy may exist
Single operator; no concurrent Wrangler/API/admin writer; tools locked locally during execution
After signup/logout and absence of external writers: record pre-import Time Travel bookmark, account/DB ID and UTC time
Actual plan retention and destructive restore permission confirmed; restore is not executed during design/test stages
Measure exact statements/binds/SQL/body size; query duration limit 30s, selected proxy whole-batch wall-clock limit not confirmed
Mandatory disposable remote D1 proof of exact proxy batch commit, rollback, postcondition failure, duplicate, network/crash handling and bind/trigger behavior; no T07 write path before PASS
Internal SQL guards and external schema/FK/raw-review/API-review/export/A-B verification separated; permission for each verified
account.accountId = user.id, providerId credential, exactly one account and no additional users/credential accounts
Explicit owner user.id AND expected email pair verified; never select owner by email alone; email masked in logs
Session count zero immediately before batch and in first atomic guard
verification zero for this email/password flow; account/session/rateLimit expected baseline, no orphan or unexpected auth state
Permissions for remote binding/edge-preview proxy startup and use confirmed without revealing credentials
Permissions and local connection plan for post-import full verification, auth API/export and A/B tests confirmed
Source text and secret leak preflight covers CLI/history/stdout/stderr/logs/temp/Git; no bind debug output
Fresh read-only remote DB state immediately before batch; single operator and no other writer
Schema fingerprint immediately before batch and matching SQL predicates in first guard; no unverified pragma table-valued functions
Seventeen trigger names/fingerprint immediately before batch and matching SQL predicates in first guard
Six business tables empty immediately before batch; atomically recheck empty in first guard
Actual account Time Travel retention and bookmark still within retention at execution
Recovery command execution permission and separate restore approval procedure confirmed; no restore during design/test

failurePolicy: Any unmet or unknown check means zero import attempts; no warning-only bypass
atomicGuard: First single-batch guard rechecks owner ID/email/accountId/provider/userId, session0, business empty, migrations and schema/trigger SQL fingerprints; same bound source bytes SHA/count plan checked before constructing batch. SQL cannot hash the local file; source SHA is a local invariant, never represented as remotely verified file access. Final SQL-failure guards enforce counts/IDs/owner/restored source fields within tested supported scope.
duplicatePolicy: Reject non-empty business DB; no overwrite/upsert; no checksum marker implemented
delayedPolicy: Compute at verified asOfKoreanDate; never assert fixed delayed=0
